name: Ants: a few who never herd
description: Alfarano and Milaković's Figure 6: the variance of the share against the fraction of ants who never herd, placed on the network — 1 000 ants, a random network with link probability 0.1, a 0.5, λ 1, 10 000 sweeps. Measured (release, seeds 1–3, recorded 2026-09-27): 0.016, 0.015, 0.014, 0.0054, 0.0035, 0.0017 at 0, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20 %. Everyone hears from them, so a few calm the whole colony: at 5 % the variance is a third of what the same ants off the network would leave (the survey: 0.0063 against 0.019). 10 000 sweeps undershoot the mean field's 0.023 with everyone herding.
